# Plugin SDK

<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

This feature allows you to enable Plugin SDK support for your app, bringing Plugin SDK capabilities to your Zoom integration.

The information in the `plugin_sdk` section of the manifest JSON represents the values on the **[Plugin SDK](/docs/plugin-sdk/)** page of the app build flow.

## Manifest JSON

```json
{
    "features": {
        // ......
        "plugin_sdk": {
            "enable": true
        }
        // ......
    }
}
```

## Field Description

| Field               | Description                                                  | Required |
| :------------------ | :----------------------------------------------------------- | :------- |
| `plugin_sdk.enable` | Enable Plugin SDK and bring Plugin SDK features to your app. | No       |
